record.original_question: For a first-countable well-filtered space X, do the upper Vietoris topology and the Scott topology on K(X), the set of nonempty compact saturated subsets of X, coincide?

evidence.quote: Question 6.13. ([54]) For a first-countable well-filtered space X, does the upper Vietoris topology and the Scott topology on K(X) coincide?
We shall use K(X) to denote the set of all nonempty compact saturated subsets of X equipped with the Smyth preorder.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let X be a topological space. A subset A of X is saturated if it equals the intersection of all open sets containing it (equivalently, A is an upper set in the specialization preorder of X). Let K(X) denote the set of all nonempty compact saturated subsets of X, ordered by reverse inclusion (the Smyth preorder: K ≤ L iff L ⊆ K).

Recall:
(i) X is well-filtered if for every filtered family {K_i}_{i∈I} ⊆ K(X) (filtered with respect to reverse inclusion, i.e. for any i, j there is k with K_k ⊆ K_i ∩ K_j) and every open U with ⋂_i K_i ⊆ U, there exists some i_0 with K_{i_0} ⊆ U.
(ii) X is first-countable if every point of X has a countable neighborhood base.
(iii) The upper Vietoris topology on K(X) has as a base the sets □U := {K ∈ K(X) : K ⊆ U}, where U ranges over the open subsets of X.
(iv) The Scott topology on K(X) (with respect to the Smyth preorder) consists of those upper sets U ⊆ K(X) such that for every directed family D ⊆ K(X) with supremum in U, some element of D lies in U.

Question: For every first-countable well-filtered space X, do the upper Vietoris topology and the Scott topology on K(X) coincide?
artifact.status_search_result: Xu and Yang (2020/2021) proved the coincidence of the upper Vietoris and Scott topologies on K(X) for first-countable well-filtered spaces X under the additional hypothesis that the set of minimal elements of every Q ∈ K(X) is countable. The general question without this countability assumption appears not to have been fully settled in the literature surveyed.

status_evidence.title: Coincidence of the upper Vietoris topology and the Scott topology
status_evidence.snippet: For a first-countable well-filtered space, if the set of minimal elements of Q is countable for every Q ∈ K(X), then the upper Vietoris topology and the Scott topology on K(X) coincide.
status_evidence.claim: Partial result under an extra countability assumption.

status_evidence.title: First-countable spaces and their Smyth powerdomain — Non-Hausdorff Topology and Domain Theory
status_evidence.snippet: the condition on the countability of Min(Q) may seem strange, but is necessary
status_evidence.claim: Indicates the general first-countable well-filtered case is not resolved without the additional countability hypothesis.
